messages:
Marina: Hey team — kicking off the SI Adoption Track Q3: expert hours + hands-on lab rotations. Goal: reduce time-to-first-proof for new SIs to <2 weeks. Agenda in this thread.
Alex: love this. can we make the first week heavy on marketplace listing + infra validation? SIs keep tripping on cloud region entitlements.
Jordan: +1. also need a single canonical TOC for marketplace docs. Right now docs are scattered across 3 repos.
Sam: flag: joint announcement windows w/ partners require 3-week embargo. if we want co-marketing with hardware partners, schedule that early in the run.
Marina: noted. thinking cadence: week 0 = onboarding call + checklist; week 1 = lab access + marketplace onboarding; week 2 = certification exam + case study prep.
Priya: for cert exam format — are we doing practical lab checkpoints or multiple choice? Practical makes more sense for SIs.
Alex: strongly prefer practical. have them deploy a tiny inference pipeline against a sample dataset, verify latency and cost metrics.
Jordan: we should include a mandatory 'hardware compatibility' lab for partners selling edge kits — simple perf sanity check and quantization test.
Marina: exact checklist draft:
  - access: console + dedicated sandbox creds
  - marketplace: publish test listing (private preview)
  - hw: run compatibility script
  - evals: 3 prompt sets, perf thresholds
  - docs: one-pager for customers
Priya: can we automate grading for the labs? automated checks reduce reviewer load.
Alex: yes — grader runs KV-cache smoke tests and compares token latency percentiles. we can share the grader via GH Action.
Marina: sample grader snippet:
```
#!/bin/bash
# run inference smoke test against sandbox
python tools/run_smoke.py --model redwood/rlhf-mini --seq 512 --requests 20 --report out.json
python tools/score_lab.py --input out.json --threshold 120
```
Sam: marketing note — avoid partner logos on any public page until legal signs off. timeline: legal review can take 5 business days.
Priya: I'll put together a rotating office-hours schedule. volunteers for week 1 expert hours?
Alex: I can take Mon/Wed 9–11 PT for infra + marketplace.
Jordan: I'll cover Tue 1–3 PT for docs and listing walkthrough.
Marina: I'll run the certification rubric review Fri 10 PT.
onboarding-bot: Event created: "SI Adoption Track — Week 0 Kickoff" Thu 15:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to participants.
Sam: quick Q — do we want to include a sandbox GPU quota note in the docs? partners often forget to request it.
Marina: yes, add a 'request GPU quota' checkbox to the onboarding checklist and a direct link to the quota form.
Priya: will do. I'll update the checklist and drop the link here by EOD.
Alex: small ops note: for private deployments, include KMS key naming convention in the lab so SIs can validate KMS integration during the cert.
Jordan: adding that to docs TOC.
Marina: thanks everyone. next steps: Priya updates checklist, Alex and Jordan produce grader + TOC, Sam creates partner comms timeline doc. We'll reconvene after the kickoff event.
Priya: got it. ping me if you need reviewer access for the sandbox.
Marina: closing thread for now — will post meeting notes after Thu's kickoff. :rocket
